sourceCache.redistribution: not-permitted-by-default; local-only cache, do not commit or publish source

research.description: A vertical SVG path with a bright gradient segment that follows the reader through a long content column.

motion.mechanism: Motion useScroll progress maps to two SVG gradient coordinates; useSpring smooths both values (stiffness 500, damping 90).
motion.trigger: Scroll within the component content area.
motion.lifecycle: Updates with scroll progress; no timer-driven autoplay. Source includes a motion-reduce:hidden class on the bright path.
motion.evidence: Official registry source inspection; native route compiled and returned HTML. Appearance, scroll response, and reduced-motion output have not been visually verified.

research.fitRationale: Could pace a validated editorial explanation of Flozio's learning cycle. Requires approved content and brand-palette review; this is not an approved homepage visual.
